name: 97056 · Scappoose, OR
findings: ZIP 97056 (Scappoose) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97056 (Scappoose) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
